description: ...Darren is a dedicated and committed individual who places great value on the success of all in our community. Simply put, He Cares!...He will listen to his constituents and ensure our voices are not only heard but our issues are addressed. Our community deserves a representative who listens first and acts with integrity. Darren will fight for each of us....
title: Russ Olsen - Darren Croft for Utah House District 41
